     1	# Architecture — trackeros
     2	
     3	## Overview
     4	
     5	The architecture is modular, with a clear separation of concerns between models, repositories, services, controllers, and routes. The backend is built using Fastify for performance, while the frontend leverages React Native for mobile and React for web, sharing contracts for type safety.
     6	
     7	## Stack
     8	
     9	- Runtime: Node 20 LTS
    10	- Package manager: npm
    11	- Test framework: Jest
    12	- Backend: Fastify
    13	- Frontend: React Native
    14	- Database: PostgreSQL
    15	
    16	## Module structure
    17	
    18	```
    19	src/modules/employee/employee.model.ts          — Employee entity + IEmployeeRepository interface
    20	src/modules/employee/employee.repository.ts     — PgEmployeeRepository (pg Pool, parameterized queries, snake_case↔camelCase mapping)
    21	src/modules/leave-policy/leave-policy.model.ts  — LeavePolicy entity + ILeavePolicyRepository + ILeavePolicyService interfaces
    22	src/modules/leave-policy/leave-policy.repository.ts — PgLeavePolicyRepository (pg Pool, parameterized queries, snake_case↔camelCase mapping)
    23	src/modules/leave-policy/leave-policy.service.ts — LeavePolicyService (stateless, delegates to ILeavePolicyRepository)
    24	src/modules/balance/balance.model.ts            — Balance entity + IBalanceRepository + IBalanceService interfaces + error classes (InsufficientBalanceError, BalanceNotFoundError)
    25	src/modules/balance/balance.repository.ts       — PgBalanceRepository (pg Pool, parameterized queries, snake_case↔camelCase mapping, dynamic UPDATE via COLUMN_MAP)
    26	src/modules/balance/balance.service.ts          — BalanceService (stateless, delegates to IBalanceRepository; enforces balance rules: throws BalanceNotFoundError / InsufficientBalanceError)
    27	src/modules/balance/balance.controller.ts       — BalanceController (Fastify handlers: getBalance, getBalances)
    28	src/modules/balance/balance.routes.ts           — Fastify plugin registering GET /balance/:employeeId/:leaveType and GET /balance/:employeeId
    29	src/modules/audit-log/audit-log.model.ts        — AuditLog entity + IAuditLogRepository interface + AuditLogValidationError
    30	src/modules/audit-log/audit-log.repository.ts   — PgAuditLogRepository (pg Pool, parameterized queries, dynamic filter construction for findAll)
    31	src/modules/leave-request/leave-request.model.ts — LeaveRequest entity + CreateLeaveRequestDto + ILeaveRequestRepository + ILeaveRequestService interfaces + error classes (LeaveRequestNotFoundError, LeaveRequestValidationError) + Zod validation schemas (createLeaveRequestSchema, updateLeaveRequestSchema)
    32	src/modules/notification/notification.model.ts  — Notification entity + INotificationRepository + INotificationService interfaces
    33	src/modules/status/                             — System status module (model, service interface, service)
    34	src/modules/uptime/                             — Uptime health-check module (model, service interface, service, routes)
    35	src/shared/types/index.ts                       — Shared enums: LeaveType, LeaveStatus, EmploymentStatus, BalanceStatus, NotificationType, NotificationStatus
    36	src/shared/db/connection.ts                     — PostgreSQL pool (pg)
    37	
    38	tests/unit/modules/employee/employee.repository.spec.ts       — Jest tests for PgEmployeeRepository (mock pg Pool)
    39	tests/unit/modules/leave-policy/leave-policy.repository.spec.ts — Jest tests for PgLeavePolicyRepository (mock pg Pool)
    40	tests/unit/modules/leave-policy/leave-policy.service.spec.ts   — Jest tests for LeavePolicyService (mock ILeavePolicyRepository)
    41	tests/unit/modules/balance/balance.repository.spec.ts          — Jest tests for PgBalanceRepository (mock pg Pool)
    42	tests/unit/modules/balance/balance.service.spec.ts             — Jest tests for BalanceService (mock IBalanceRepository)
    43	tests/unit/modules/audit-log/audit-log.repository.spec.ts      — Jest tests for PgAuditLogRepository (mock pg Pool)
    44	```
    45	
    46	## Key patterns
    47	
    48	- See `AGENTS.md` for stack-specific coding conventions
    49	- See `docs/GOLDEN_PRINCIPLES.md` for the non-negotiable rules every
    50	  cycle is checked against
    51	- Repository implementations use a `mapRowTo*` function to convert
    52	  snake_case database rows to camelCase entity objects, and a
    53	  `COLUMN_MAP` lookup for dynamic UPDATE SET clause construction.
    54	  All queries use parameterized placeholders (`$1`, `$2`, …).
    55	- Tests use Jest with `ts-jest` preset. Repository tests mock the pg
    56	  `Pool` from `src/shared/db/connection` via `jest.mock`. Service tests
    57	  mock the repository interface directly. Test helpers (`makeEmployeeRow`,
    58	  `makeEmployee`, `makePolicyRow`, `makePolicy`, `makeBalanceRow`,
    59	  `makeBalance`, `makeAuditLogRow`, `makeAuditLog`) produce canonical test
    60	  fixtures.
    61	- Domain error classes carry a `code` property for HTTP mapping
    62	  (e.g. `InsufficientBalanceError.code = 'INSUFFICIENT_BALANCE'`,
    63	  `BalanceNotFoundError.code = 'NOT_FOUND'`,
    64	  `AuditLogValidationError.code = 'VALIDATION_ERROR'`,
    65	  `LeaveRequestNotFoundError.code = 'NOT_FOUND'`,
    66	  `LeaveRequestValidationError.code = 'VALIDATION_ERROR'`).
    67	
    68	## Dependency rules
    69	
    70	- Modules import from each other ONLY through their declared public
    71	  entry point (`index.ts`, `__init__.py`, package root — whatever the
    72	  stack uses)
    73	- All database access goes through a repository layer — no inline SQL
    74	  / ORM calls in route handlers or business logic
    75	- No circular dependencies between modules

    78	# Leave Management Module Architecture
    79	
    80	## Overview
    81	Modular monolith built with TypeScript, Fastify, PostgreSQL. The leave management module enables employees to apply for annual, sick, and emergency leave, managers to approve/reject, and the system to track leave balances.
    82	
    83	## Domain Entities
    84	- **LeaveRequest** – core leave application with lifecycle: DRAFT → SUBMITTED → APPROVED/REJECTED/CANCELLED.
    85	- **LeavePolicy** – rules per leave type (entitlement, accrual, notice, approval requirement).
    86	- **Employee** – employee record with employment status and reporting line.
    87	- **Balance** – per-employee, per-leave-type, per-fiscal-year entitlement tracking.
    88	- **Notification** – event-driven notifications for leave lifecycle events.
    89	
    90	## Modules
    91	| Module | Path | Responsibility |
    92	|--------|------|----------------|
    93	| shared-types | src/shared/types/ | Enums: LeaveType, LeaveStatus, EmploymentStatus, BalanceStatus, NotificationType, NotificationStatus |
    94	| employee | src/modules/employee/ | Employee entity, repository |
    95	| leave-policy | src/modules/leave-policy/ | LeavePolicy entity, repository, service |
    96	| balance | src/modules/balance/ | Balance entity, repository, service, controller, routes, error classes |
    97	| leave-request | src/modules/leave-request/ | LeaveRequest entity, repository interface, service interface, DTOs, Zod schemas, error classes |
    98	| notification | src/modules/notification/ | Notification entity, repository interface, service interface |
    99	| audit-log | src/modules/audit-log/ | AuditLog entity, repository, error class |
   100	
   101	## Dependency Map
   102	- leave-request → shared-types, balance, leave-policy, employee, notification, audit-log
   103	- balance → shared-types, leave-policy, employee
   104	- leave-policy → shared-types
   105	- employee → shared-types
   106	- notification → shared-types, employee, leave-request (type import only)
   107	- audit-log → shared-types, employee
   108	
   109	## Database Tables (Conceptual)
   110	- **leave_requests** (id, employee_id, leave_type, start_date, end_date, reason, status, approved_by, approved_at, rejection_reason, created_at, updated_at)
   111	- **leave_balances** (id, employee_id, leave_type, fiscal_year, total_entitlement, used_days, remaining_days, status, created_at, updated_at)
   112	- **leave_policies** (id, policy_name, leave_type, entitlement_days, accrual_rate, max_accumulation, minimum_notice_days, requires_manager_approval, is_active, created_at, updated_at)
   113	- **employees** (id, employee_number, first_name, last_name, email, manager_id, department, hire_date, termination_date, employment_status, created_at, updated_at, deleted_at)
   114	- **audit_logs** (id, entity_type, entity_id, action, old_values, new_values, performed_by, performed_at, created_at)
   115	- **notifications** (id, recipient_id, type, title, message, related_entity_type, related_entity_id, status, created_at, read_at)
   116	
   117	## Cross-Cutting Contracts
   118	- **Auth**: JWT bearer token → `request.user: { id: string; role: UserRole }` where `UserRole = 'employee' | 'manager' | 'hr_admin'`. RBAC enforced via `requireRole(...)` middleware.
   119	- **Error Response**: `{ error: string; code: string }`. HTTP 400 (VALIDATION_ERROR), 401 (UNAUTHORIZED), 403 (FORBIDDEN), 404 (NOT_FOUND), 422 (INSUFFICIENT_BALANCE), 409 (OVERLAPPING_REQUEST).
   120	- **Transaction**: Multi-step writes (approve/cancel) use a caller-owned transaction. Repository methods accept an optional `pg.PoolClient`; the service acquires a client, runs `BEGIN`, passes it to repositories, then `COMMIT`/`ROLLBACK`.
   121	
   122	## Phased Implementation
   123	1. **Foundation**: shared-types, employee, leave-policy (models + repositories + service + tests done)
   124	2. **Balance & Audit**: balance module (models, repository, service, controller, routes, tests done), audit-log module (models, repository, tests done)
   125	3. **Core Workflow — Models**: leave-request module (model, DTOs, repository interface, service interface, Zod schemas, error classes done), notification module (model, repository interface, service interface done)
   126	4. **Core Workflow — Implementations**: leave-request repository, service, controller, routes; notification repository, service (pending)
   127	
   128	## Implementation Notes
   129	- Balance routes are defined as a Fastify plugin (`balanceRoutes`) but are **not yet registered** in `src/app.ts` — integration will happen in a follow-up phase.
   130	- The `IBalanceService` interface includes `getBalances(employeeId)` returning all balances for an employee, in addition to the single-type `getBalance`.
   131	- `PgBalanceRepository.deductDays` uses a SQL `CASE` expression to set `status` to `'exhausted'` when `remaining_days` reaches 0 or below.
   132	- `PgAuditLogRepository.findAll` builds dynamic WHERE clauses from optional filter parameters using indexed placeholders.
   133	- `ILeaveRequestRepository.updateStatus` documents allowed state transitions: DRAFT→SUBMITTED, SUBMITTED→APPROVED|REJECTED, SUBMITTED|APPROVED→CANCELLED. REJECTED/CANCELLED are terminal.
   134	- `ILeaveRequestService` methods document their error contracts: `submit` throws `LeaveRequestValidationError` for invalid input plus domain errors for business rule violations; `approve`/`reject` throw `LeaveRequestNotFoundError`; `cancel` enforces self-cancellation (employeeId must match).
   135	- `createLeaveRequestSchema` uses Zod `.refine()` to enforce `startDate <= endDate`.
   136	- `Notification` model imports `LeaveRequest` as a **type-only** import from `../leave-request/leave-request.model` — this is a cross-module dependency for the service interface signatures only.
   137	
   138	## Open Question
   139	- Day-counting semantics (inclusive calendar days vs business days) – see open questions list.
